test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

With the increasing reliance on digital systems, ensuring robust cybersecurity measures is ____________ to protect against online threats.
solution:
The correct answer is '**paramount**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**paramount**" means more important than anything else or of utmost importance. (सर्वोपरि)
 
• In the context of cybersecurity, ensuring robust measures is critical to protect against online threats.
 
• The other options: "**superfluous**" (अतिरिक्त), "**extraneous**" (अप्रासंगिक), and "**impartial**" (निष्पक्ष) do not appropriately fit the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *With the increasing reliance on digital systems, ensuring robust cybersecurity measures is paramount__ to protect against online threats.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Superfluous (अतिरिक्त)**: means unnecessary or redundant.
 
• **Extraneous (अप्रासंगिक)**: means irrelevant or unrelated to the subject.
 
• **Impartial (निष्पक्ष)**: means unbiased or fair.
